Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL on culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
